description: 700 synthetic people with saved strong-valid, weak-valid and exclusion-violating instrument scenarios.
observation_unit: One synthetic person, with alternate scenario columns on the same row
source: Original synthetic OpenEconometrics teaching data; not real observations.

columns.name: person
columns.description: Synthetic person identifier; common across all three scenarios.

columns.name: offer
columns.description: Randomized fictional scholarship offer; excluded instrument.

columns.name: schooling
columns.description: Schooling exposure in the strong-valid instrument scenario.

columns.name: log_earnings
columns.description: Natural log of hourly earnings in the strong-valid scenario.
columns.unit: Log hypothetical currency units per hour

columns.name: schooling_weak
columns.description: Saved schooling exposure in the weak-valid instrument scenario.

columns.name: schooling_invalid
columns.description: Saved schooling exposure in the strong instrument scenario with violated exclusion.

columns.name: log_earnings_weak
columns.description: Saved log hourly earnings in the weak-valid instrument scenario.
columns.unit: Log hypothetical currency units per hour

columns.name: log_earnings_invalid
columns.description: Saved log hourly earnings with a direct offer effect, violating exclusion.
columns.unit: Log hypothetical currency units per hour
